create_phi4_multimodal_image_processor: create a Phi4MultimodalImageProcessor instance to preprocess images for the Phi-4 Multimodal model
build_dynamic_image_crop: build dynamic image cropping that resizes and pads images to fit the model's patch-based attention grid
run_image_preprocess_pipeline: run the preprocess pipeline to produce image_pixel_values, image_sizes, and image_attention_mask tensors
pad_crops_to_max_num: pad a batch of image crops and attention masks to a specified maximum number of crops
find_closest_aspect_ratio: find the closest matching aspect ratio from a set of target ratios for dynamic image resizing
